title: ci(type-check): the affected speed builds the packages the repo-root setup program imports (objectui#12272)
body:
Fixes #12272
Clause-②: no

Since objectui#12222 (PR #12251) a pull request or queue build type-checks the affected set, `pnpm type-check "--filter=...[BASE]"`. That run builds only the dependencies of what it selects, so on a diff outside every package it builds nothing, and the root step `pnpm type-check:vitest-setup` cannot resolve the five workspace packages the root `vitest.setup.*` files import (PR #12262: four TS2882, one TS2307, job red). This PR adds one step, on the affected speed only, that builds those packages before the root program; `push` and `schedule` are unchanged.

## What changed

- **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, the `type-check` job only:** a new step `Build the packages the repo-root programs import` between `Run type-check` and `Type-check repo-root vitest setup files`, gated on `scope == 'affected'` (plus the job's `should_run`). It runs `pnpm exec turbo run build` with one `--filter` per package, replayed from the restored cache when the hash did not move, and prints turbo's own `Cached:` line as one `::notice` (job logs are not readable from a seat container; annotations are). It asks for no run summary, so `Report what the turbo cache replayed` still reads `Run type-check`'s. The comment on the vitest-setup step names the new step.
- **`scripts/select-type-check-scope.mjs`:** `--root-builds` prints the packages, read on every run out of `tsconfig.vitest-setup.json`'s `paths` with TypeScript's own config parser (each target walked up to its package, so `./packages/i18n/dist/*` is `@object-ui/i18n`), never copied; a target in no package throws. The affected verdict also lists them, so the decide step's log says what the build step will build.
- **`scripts/__tests__/select-type-check-scope.test.ts`:** the empty-affected case (the PR #12262 diff shape) and the affected-set-without-the-five case (`@object-ui/plugin-ai` alone) both name the five; `--root-builds` prints exactly them; the derivation equals the `@object-ui/*` packages the setup program's files import; a target outside every package throws; the step's wiring (position, `scope == 'affected'`, `turbo run build`, `set -o pipefail`, no run summary).
- **`content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`:** the `type-check` row names `turbo run build` (the doc pin requires every command the job runs) and says why it runs.

## Route, measured first

| measurement (turbo 2.10.9, dry runs on `7af0ab37`) | five packages' `build` in the run |
|---|---|
| `turbo run type-check --filter=...[BASE]`, empty diff | none (0 tasks) |
| `turbo run type-check --filter=...@object-ui/plugin-ai` (a package-only diff) | 2 of 5 (fields, plugin-dashboard, plugin-grid missing) |
| route A as worded: `turbo run type-check` plus `--filter` for each of the five | 3 of 5: `plugin-dashboard` and `plugin-grid` missing, because `type-check` waits on `^build` (dependencies' builds) and never builds a named package's own |
| `turbo run type-check` plus `PKG#build` on the command line | 5 of 5, but turbo also adds the five packages' `type-check` and the uncached e2e root task (23 tasks on an empty diff) |
| route B: a root task `//#type-check:vitest-setup` with `dependsOn` on the five builds | 5 of 5 when named with the `//#` prefix (18 tasks on an empty diff, 20 on the plugin-ai diff); named bare, the filter drops it (0 tasks) |
| **chosen:** `turbo run build` with a `--filter` per package, its own step | 5 of 5 (16 tasks run) |

Why this one over route B: the full battery stays exactly as it is (the new step is skipped on `push` and `schedule`); the root program keeps its deliberately direct, uncached step (the reason is written on that step: no cache key may decide its verdict); `turbo.json` is untouched, which keeps this PR's own diff package-less, so its own `Type Check` run takes the defect's path; and the package list is derived from the tsconfig instead of being a second copy in `dependsOn`. Route C (skip on an empty set) was not taken: the plugin-ai row shows a non-empty set failing the same way.

The other root programs this job compiles need nothing built: `type-check:scripts` and `type-check:vitest-config` each pin that their program imports no workspace package, and the e2e program's two `@object-ui/*` occurrences are stub-map keys in `e2e/sidebar-offcanvas-geometry.spec.ts` and `e2e/toast-under-modal.spec.ts`, not imports.

## Local proof: the YAML's own steps, run as CI runs them

A one-off harness (not committed) parses `ci.yml` and executes the `run:` text of every step from `Decide which packages to type-check` through `Type-check repo-root vitest setup files` as a `pull_request` event, with `GITHUB_OUTPUT`, `RUNNER_TEMP`, the `if:` conditions and the `env:` expressions evaluated; no `dist/` anywhere before each run.

| run | tree | result |
|---|---|---|
| defect reproduced | `7af0ab37` (`origin/main` then), empty diff, the three commands by hand | selector `scope=affected`, turbo "No tasks were executed", vitest-setup **exit 2** (the same five errors as PR #12262) |
| fix, cold cache | `b1b76e03` | build step 16 tasks, 1 cached, turbo 2m3s on the shared 4-core box; vitest-setup **exit 0** |
| fix, warm cache (H1) | `bf00a181` | build step `Cached: 16 cached, 16 total`, turbo 138 ms, step 1.1 s; vitest-setup **exit 0** |
| fix, final head | `24c8c17c`, base `1fb1ced3` | 4 files changed, zero packages; build step 16 of 16 cached; vitest-setup **exit 0** |
| affected set without the five | a never-pushed probe commit on `24c8c17c` touching `packages/plugin-ai/src/AIFormAssist.tsx` | selector lists `@object-ui/plugin-ai` alone; `Run type-check` 10 tasks; build step 16 of 16 cached; vitest-setup **exit 0** |
| ablation, empty diff | `bf00a181` with `ci.yml` replaced by the base's (the step gone), the committed selector untouched | vitest-setup **exit 2**, the five errors again |
| ablation, plugin-ai probe | the plugin-ai probe with the same `ci.yml` swap | vitest-setup **exit 2**, exactly fields, plugin-dashboard and plugin-grid |

Each ablation restored `ci.yml` with `git checkout HEAD -- .github/workflows/ci.yml`, then compared the blob hash with the `HEAD` blob (match) and read `git diff HEAD` empty. A test-level ablation at `bf00a181` (the same `ci.yml` swap) turns the new wiring test red: 1 failed, 19 passed; restored, 20 passed.

## Verification (local, at `24c8c17c`)

- Every test file that reads `ci.yml`, `turbo.json`, the CI doc, the selector or `tsconfig.vitest-setup.json` (selected by `git grep`): 76 files, 2,541 tests passed.
- Gates, hand-derived from this repository's workflows (the objectstack derivation script refuses a sister repository): `check-control-bytes`, `check-action-ref-convention`, `check-shell-escape-residue`, `check-bash32-floor`, `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-component-types`, `check-doc-json-fences`, `check-doc-fence-languages`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-type-check-coverage`, `check-required-check-set --self-test`, `check-pre-install-import-graph`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-lint-coverage`, `check-changeset-presence` (none owed: no published source changed), `check-entry-guard`, `check:docs-route-closure`, `pnpm type-check:scripts`, eslint with `--no-inline-config` over the changed script and test, a strict YAML parse of `ci.yml`, a control-byte scan of the four files: all exit 0. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` answers NOT GOVERNED for the four paths; the card sets this PR to draft anyway (Tier H for workflows).
- `origin/main` (PR #12263, `1fb1ced3`) merged in, not rebased; one conflict in two adjacent rows of the CI doc's job table, resolved as this branch's `type-check` row and main's `test` row.
- NOT MEASURED here: this PR's own `Type Check` run, which is the live package-less case (its four files are outside every package and none is a root-rule file); PR #12262 after this lands; `actionlint` (not installed); repo-wide `pnpm lint` (CI's Lint job).

## Acceptance notes

- `tsconfig.vitest-setup.json`'s own comment says the ci.yml step "sits after `pnpm type-check`" so the declarations exist; since objectui#12222 that holds on the full and workspace speeds only, and the new step covers the affected one. Not edited here: it is outside the card's file surface, and a root `tsconfig*.json` is a root-rule file, so editing it would move this PR to `scope=workspace` and lose the live run of the defect's path. Carrier: none.
- `scripts/__tests__/vitest-setup-type-check.test.ts`'s ordering pin still locates the bare `pnpm type-check` line (the full and workspace branch); the affected branch's ordering is pinned in `select-type-check-scope.test.ts`.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:`Type Check` 作业在「只检查受影响包」的快速档(PR 与合并队列)新增一步:在类型检查之后、仓根 `vitest.setup.*` 的 tsc 之前,用 `turbo run build` 构建这些 setup 文件引用的五个包(components、fields、plugin-dashboard、plugin-grid、i18n)。包清单每次从 `tsconfig.vitest-setup.json` 的 `paths` 读出,不另抄一份;未变的包直接从缓存回放。`push` 与每小时 `schedule` 的全量档完全不变。

**为什么改**:#12251 上线两档速度后,一个不碰任何包的 PR(如只改 workflow 或文档的 PR #12262)选中零个包、什么都不构建,仓根那一步找不到这五个包的类型声明而报错,`Type Check` 变红;只改 `plugin-ai` 这类选中了包、但依赖闭包里没有这五个的 PR 同样会红。卡片原文的路线 A(把五个包加进 type-check 的过滤器)经实测不够:type-check 只构建依赖,不构建被点名包自己,plugin-dashboard 与 plugin-grid 仍缺。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:快速档多一次 turbo 构建;缓存命中时本地实测约 1 秒,冷缓存约 2 分钟(16 个任务,共享 4 核机器)。全量档不受影响。回滚:revert 本 PR 即恢复原状(届时不碰包的 PR 会重新变红)。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:审阅后给一条批准(本轮 workflow 改动按 Tier H 停在 draft);落地后由席位把 `origin/main` 合进 PR #12262 并读它的 `Type Check`。
